hook: A new breed of chip runs AI models using waves
hookText: A new breed of chip runs AI models using waves

beats.say: A new kind of chip runs AI models with light waves instead of electricity, promising faster and more efficient inference.
Whereas regular GPUs transmit and process data by shuffling electrons around, photonic processors use waves of light.

If hypothetically we received an order of 100,000 [photonic processors], we at Q.ANT are ready, but I’m not sure about the suppliers. [To produce Q.ANT chips] you only need 90 nanometer node technology, from the 2000s.
